newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 355-358 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 355-358 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 355-358 per dollar in light interbank trade, down from 350-355 in the morning due to the longer value date of spot deals, dealers said.

"Today's fall was a normal market reaction in view of the large spread between interest rates on lev- and dollar denominated investments under the longer value date of today's spot deals," a commercial bank dealer said.
The value date of Thursday's spot deals falls on Monday, allowing for a daily easing of more than one lev per dollar under the current interest rate of 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
The BNB bought small dollar volumes at 351-353 levs in the morning, dealers said.

The lev traded between 348-355 in the past three days after the central bank (BNB) said on Friday it had agreed to coordinated action with commercial banks to prevent new sharp falls in the lev, which slumped from 275 to 395 last week. @

Foreign currency supply began rising on profit taking on Monday and the central bank has absorbed part of the rise since then, keeping the lev stable near 350, traders said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
